Spiraling Sphere. The legacy jutsu of the Yondaime. You compress raw chakra into a perfectly spherical orb in your palm; on contact it drills, tears, and unloads concentric kinetic shockwaves.

Make a melee spell attack roll against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes 6d10 force damage. On a hit, the target is also pushed 10 feet directly away from you (no save) and becomes off-guard until the end of their next turn. On a critical hit, double the damage and push distance.

Rasengan does not require hand seals once mastered, but you must have at least one hand free.

Heightened (+1) Damage increases by 1d10.
